subject: Novaflow POC top-up options and short extension request
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novaflow.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novaflow POC top-up options and short extension request

Hi Asha / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great to see the ingestion pipeline and the low-latency tests. Per our conversation, I put together two practical options to keep the POC running while you complete larger scale data ingest: a short time extension (3 weeks) or a credit top-up (token/throughput bucket).

Attached: Novaflow_POC_pricing_options_v2.pdf (summary table + economics) and a draft SOW addendum. High-level options:
- Option A: 3-week extension, flat fee $8,500 (adds priority Dedicated pool windows for the duration).
- Option B: Credit bucket — 200k token-equivalent credits at $0.035/token effective ( ~15% discount vs standard pay-as-you-go), valid for 60 days.

Quick questions:
- Do you need the extension to include higher concurrency windows (we can reserve a 2-hour daily burst)?
- Procurement point of contact to route an addendum if you pick Option A?

If either path works I'll route to Marissa for a one-time concession approval (we can offer up to one small concession without executive signoff). Happy to hop on a 20-min call this afternoon to pick one.

Best,

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novaflow_POC_pricing_options_v2.pdf (pdf), POC_Addendum_SOW_draft.docx (docx)

From: Asha Kapoor <asha@novaflow.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novaflow POC top-up options and short extension request

Thanks Sergio — helpful breakdown. Quick answers:

- We want to extend the POC by 3 weeks and also add burst capacity for two 1-hour windows daily (we'll try heavy backfill).
- Procurement contact is procurement@novaflow.ai; cc'd Jordan for SOW review.

One ask from our side: can you move Option B pricing to $0.030/token for the 200k credit bucket if we sign the addendum this week? That bridges our internal approvals. If not, we prefer Option A but would ask for a 10% discount on the flat fee.

Also curious whether credits can be split across two teams (ingest and search) without separate SKUs.

—Asha
Asha Kapoor
Head of Data Platform, Novaflow
asha@novaflow.ai

Subject: Fwd: Novaflow POC top-up options and short extension request

Marissa / Naomi — looping you both in. Novaflow is asking to either: 1) extend 3 weeks with daily 2x 1-hour burst windows or 2) buy a 200k token-equivalent credit bucket. They asked if we can move Option B to $0.030/token (effective concession ~28% vs list for that volume) or give 10% off the flat extension fee.

My read: Novaflow is close to a conversion signal — they'd sign quickly if we match the credit price or take a small concession on the extension. Naomi, we'll need your input on technical gating for splitting credits across teams and whether burst windows require an SLA change. Marissa, any flexibility on a one-time discount approval? If you prefer, we can offer a conditional trade: Option B at $0.032/token + commit to a 6-week onboarding plan and a product review milestone.

I set this as time-sensitive — procurement wants an answer this week.

Thanks,
Sergio

Subject: Re: Novaflow POC top-up options and short extension request

Sergio — thanks for the context. I approve a one-time concession under the following structured options (pick one; any selected option will be added to an addendum that Legal will sign off on):

Option 1 (time-extension preferred):
- 3-week extension at $7,650 (10% off your flat fee).
- Includes the requested daily two 1-hour burst windows (we'll reserve capacity and tag requests).
- No change to billing model.

Option 2 (credit bucket):
- 200k token-equivalent bucket at $0.032/token (total $6,400). This is a limited concession that requires a statement of work addendum signed this week and a follow-up conversion discussion within 6 weeks.
- Credits may be used by multiple internal teams under the same account; we'll configure team labels so usage is tracked separately but billed from the same bucket.

Trade: If Novaflow commits to a 12-month post-POC evaluation contract by Sept 30, we can consider moving to $0.030/token — that requires an ARR-linked incentive and exec approval.

Next steps: Sergio, please confirm which Option A/Option B Novaflow prefers. I'll ask Legal to prep a short addendum (2 pages) and we'll include DocuSign link. I've attached a revision to the pricing options and the SOW draft.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

I've attached the signed addendum placeholder (we'll route a final DocuSign after Legal redlines). HubSpot Deal NW-2026-1187 will be updated to reflect the addendum and the revised ARR assumptions.

Naomi — can your team enable the burst tagging and confirm the reserved capacity windows (we'd like them active by Monday morning PST)? Marissa — can Legal expedite the 2-page addendum and send DocuSign to procurement@novaflow.ai?

I'll mark the deal stage as 'POC Addendum Signed (pending docs)'.

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.
